scope: Read-only metadata, archived source/control flow and original execution transcript review; no layer/network/crypto replay, candidate promotion, guard update, repository changes or adoption.

control_flow_review.immutable_download: Bounded exact descriptor, guarded Range offset/total, full compressed SHA and size before atomic verified rename; only transport partials retained; all policy/hash failures fail closed.
control_flow_review.layer: Verified full compressed file rehash if resumed; then complete uncompressed read, 64GiB bound and exact config DiffID; witness written only after all checks, then own exact file deleted with witness hash.
control_flow_review.failure: Future errors propagate and prevent reconstruction/final completion; only unstarted own tasks canceled; completed per-layer receipts remain independently reusable.
control_flow_review.final: Start helper/policy hashes rechecked unchanged; exact source/subject keyless commands, tlog/TSA material and report binders retained; final receipt after all tasks/reports/blob checks.

custody_limitations: Original exact driver argv is absent; actual session25565, exit0, pinned executed helper/policy, archived V7/V8 measurement transcript, exact candidate final receipt and successful progress are retained.
Earlier transport checkpoint/failed-review files are historical failed attempts; successful V8 receipt does not turn those attempts into successes.
ARM derived75a891 is computed but not actual signed root; actual signed ARM c72c remains direct.
minimal_durable_owned_files: Root already copied complete201-file compact set with all raw metadata,33 witnesses, executed V7/V8/policy, actual stdout/exit/cleanup and prior accepted Node14 reuse is durably linked; do not retain/re-download deleted compressed layer bodies.
